purpose: Reviewable historical listing proof only; not imported, not full daily/lifetime totals, not recent coverage or wash clearance

excluded_events.rule: Exclude the known exploit block 23273098 and all later observed events; conservative temporal boundary

paired_standard_event.counting_rule: These are two representations of one logical swap; do not add both to swap count.
